title: UK Space Agency calls for proposals to deliver ESERO-UK
excerpt: The agency and the European Space Agency are offering up to approximately 5,138,700 pounds in co-funding.
bodyHtml:
The UK Space Agency announced on October 14, 2026, that it is inviting proposals to deliver ESERO-UK, which is a UK-wide space education and engagement programme, from financial years 2027/28 to 2029/30.

The UK Space Agency is offering funding of up to £4.5 million, while the European Space Agency expects to provide up to €750,000, which is approximately £638,700, over the same period. The total co-funding envelope available is approximately £5,138,700 from April 2027 to March 2030.

Applicants should submit proposals for the full UK Space Agency and European Space Agency co-funded envelope. Key dates for the grant call include a market engagement webinar on 28 October 2026.

The application deadline is 11:59 pm UK time, 20 January 2027. Successful applicants will be notified on 24 February 2027, with the grant start date on 1 April 2027.
